listbox.$description: Selectable-options dropdown (ARIA listbox/option) — the panel Select opens, and reusable anywhere else a multi/single-select list is needed. Distinct from Menu: options carry persistent selection state (checked/selected), Menu's items are one-shot actions. Same panel shell as Menu/Popover (border.default + shadow.sm + radius.default, native popover attribute) — only the option row and two optional header pieces (search, select-all/clear-all) are new. Single-select shows a trailing checkmark on the selected option (check.svg, fill.primary) and closes on pick, like a native <select>. Multi-select shows a real Checkbox marker per option (identical tokens to the actual Checkbox component: dim.5 box, radius.xs, borderWidth dim.0_5, fill.primary when checked) and stays open across picks. Search reuses Search component's own sm-size tokens verbatim (height/paddingX/iconSize/gap, surface.sunken bg) rather than re-deriving a new small-input recipe. Select-all/Clear-all row only makes sense for multi-select — clear-all uses text-style.link-sm (the same underlined-link style already defined for exactly this kind of inline action), not a button.

optionRadius.$description: Concentric with the panel, same reasoning as Menu's itemRadius.

padding.$description: 4px outer padding around the option list, same as Menu.

optionGap.$description: 8px between a marker (checkbox/checkmark) and the option label.

maxHeight.$description: 288px — long option lists scroll inside the panel rather than growing it indefinitely.

selected.$description: Single-select only — trailing checkmark, text color unchanged. The option itself doesn't get a background tint; the checkmark alone signals selection, same as a native <select> convention (Radix Select does the same).

checkbox.$description: Multi-select marker — literally the real Checkbox component's own tokens, not re-derived, so a Listbox option's checkbox is pixel-identical to a standalone Checkbox.

search.$description: Reuses Search component's own sm size + default state tokens verbatim — see search.tokens.json, not re-declared here.

gapBelow.$description: 4px between the search field and the divider under it.
